newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Midmacor to buy control of I B Joffe.
newsitem.headline: Midmacor to buy control of I B Joffe.

text.p: South African leather and canvas goods maker I B Joffe Ltd said on Thursday that it had sealed an agreement for Midmacor Industries Ltd to buy a controlling stake in the group.
The firm said the deal was still subject to certain conditions being met and the conclusion of a formal agreement between controlling shareholders and Midmacor.
"Accordingly, holders of I B Joffe ordinary shares are advised to continue to exercise caution in dealing with their shares until publication of a further announcement," the firm said.
